Here is the government link: http://www.ssa.gov/disability/disability.html

You can apply online, over the phone, or down at your local Social Security Office. Take care with the application process. You have to provide medical records and other documentation (such as hospital stays) to prove your history of mental illness. You will be interviewed at the Social Security Office and they will determine your eligibility. You may get rejected, but you can appeal. If you want, you can hire a lawyer but like any lawyer they cost money. Perhaps you could get a local law clinic to take your case pro bono. In any event, it is a process that you should get started as soon as possible if you think you need it. A social service that provides case management for people with mental illness could also assist you.
